title: House with Chimaeras

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain on the Bankova Street approach to the main door.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap Bankova 10 footprint and the named House with Chimaeras node.
mapIdentity.scope: Exact OpenStreetMap Bankova 10 ring, named house address, public original landscape and verified November 2008 frontal photograph.

note: Bankova Street has three principal levels, a tall left bay and a recessed entrance portico. The corner and downhill wings expose six levels. Carved cement marine creatures, hunting trophies, foliage, frog finials and human figures crown the cornices.
